name: WikiContradict
description: WikiContradict is a benchmark consisting of 253 human-annotated instances designed to evaluate LLM performance on questions with real-world knowledge conflicts from Wikipedia. It assesses how models handle contradictory retrieved passages under various QA scenarios, including retrieval-augmented generation with single and multiple contradictory passages.
reputation: A recent, niche benchmark for contradiction handling in retrieval-augmented QA that is not yet broadly established as a community standard.
notes: Includes human evaluations and an automated metric with F-score 0.8; focuses on knowledge conflicts from Wikipedia passages.
